title: S08 ISOLATED: hand-seeded party-of-5 entry at the Band 3->4 crossing -> ironwood -> saddle & riding -> three captains -> three Sigils
_comment_record_hz: This isolated run has no evidence-lane obligation (no S08ISOC capture companion exists) and takes no capture/capture_seq step, so the section H continuous recorder is turned off outright rather than left at the journey default -- this process is plain --headless logic mode with no display server, and the capture pre-flight refuses to start ANY segment (capture-bearing or not) that asks for frames it cannot take.
_comment: NOT the official Gate F S08.json. This is a scoped, isolated re-entry test built for a hand-authored 'clean' save (party already 5, saddle already carried) rather than the organic S07-exit a full chained run would produce. It reuses the same production paths (title Load, real movement, real combat, real gate/flag checks) and the same anchor coordinates the official S07/S08 segments use (RT-09/RT-10 in ralph/GATE_F_MASTER_PROTOCOL.md section D), but skips the catching-to-fill-the-belt and saddle-crafting steps that do not apply to this seed, and skips capture/screenshot steps entirely since this run has no evidence-lane obligation. See ralph/reports/gate-f-leg-s08/REPORT.md for the seed's stated assumptions.

steps.title: entry mechanics

args.text: Entry save is a hand-authored stand-in for S07-exit (ralph/reports/gate-f-leg-s08/saves/S07-exit.json): party of 5 (levels 14-16), full HP, a saddle already in the satchel, every flag through mill_crossing_restored set. This is CONDITIONAL/ISOLATED evidence -- S08, given a clean entry, does X -- never a claim about the whole chapter.

steps.expected: the riding camera and mounted locomotion take over

steps.title: FINDING: the direct grove->captain_field line snags the mount

args.what: A first attempt rode the direct line from the grove toward (170,5590) at the expected ~10 m/s (Meadowhart's ride_speed_multiplier 2.0 x 5.0 m/s walk_speed -- confirmed correct and sustained for most of the route from route.csv) but stalled into a tight (~3 m) back-and-forth oscillation loop at TWO points on that direct line -- around (35,0,5447) for ~56 s and again around (98,1,5512) for the remainder of the budget, never reaching the target. Whatever is at those two spots, the mount's own collider (species.json placeholder radius 0.74 m, larger than the player's own) could not get past it on a straight approach, and the un-pathfound stick_navigator steering oscillated against it rather than finding a way around. This leg is now routed wide of both points instead, so the rest of S08 can be tested; the snag itself is recorded here rather than silently routed around unremarked.

steps.expected: a defect event carries this finding into events.jsonl

steps.title: a jump, in case anything is still snagged from the last attempt
steps.expected: harmless if not caught on anything; a possible unstick if the mount's collider is resting against geometry

steps.title: ride wide of the first snag point
steps.expected: routes east of the (35,5447) stall point found above rather than through it. NOTE (consistent across every run of this leg): still stops ~92m short at a THIRD snag point near (4,-1,5395), on the wide-routed line itself. Same class of finding as ISO-22a (the mount's larger collider, per species.json's placeholder radius, catching on something the un-pathfound stick_navigator's straight-line steering cannot route around) rather than a new one -- not chased further because ISO-23-2 and ISO-23 both still complete the journey to the captain from wherever this leg leaves off, so it does not block the segment.

steps.title: ride wide of the second snag point
steps.expected: routes east of the (98,5512) stall point found above rather than through it

steps.title: fight round 1: quick attacks
